subject: Every model call of every retained run, labelled by failure source

method.input: retained .factory/events.jsonl traces; each model_request/model_response pair and the tool_start/tool_result events it produced form one row
method.prices: CNY per million tokens from docs/token-accounting-2026-09-14.md: deepseek-v4-flash 3.0/0.1/9.0, deepseek-v4-pro 9.0/0.3/27.0, kimi-k3 20.0/2.0/100.0, qwen3.6-flash 1.2/-/7.2 with every prompt token billed at the miss rate because its cache-hit tier was never observed
method.validation: the five official Ticket Booking runs of 2026-09-14 reconstruct their official charge to six decimals from these rows alone

categories.product_assertion: a behavioral check ran and the product failed it
categories.check_defect: the check log shows misuse of the check's own API, not product evidence
categories.edit_not_applied: an edit tool rejected the call, so nothing was written
categories.no_op_diagnosis: the call executed only read-only tools and produced no verification
categories.harness_error: a tool refused the call (protected path, read bound, unknown tool)
categories.harness_guard: a harness guard rejected the product source before checks ran
categories.environment_error: dependency install, build or server startup failed
categories.wrote_no_verification: files were written with no verification in the same call; progress, not waste, on the incremental path
categories.ran_check_only: a check was run through the run tool, outside verification
categories.delivered: a verification in this call passed
categories.no_tool_call: the gateway returned no executable tool call

method.budget_note: No call is labelled "budget". Budget exhaustion terminates a run between calls, so it is a run outcome, not a call category; the runs that ended that way are named in terminal_outcomes.
method.unverified_tail: Per run: tokens spent after the last call that produced a verification, without producing another. It depends only on which calls ran a real build/start/check cycle, not on how any read or write is classified, so it is the target the diagnosis-stall bound is measured against.

terminal_outcomes.official 8abb7f040604 image-qwen: budget exhausted one call after a plausible fix, FAILED
terminal_outcomes.archive e056-dev34-public-flash: budget exhausted after thirteen consecutive read-only calls
terminal_outcomes.archive e057-dev35-repair-flash: delivered locally at call 2; the official run timed out during evaluation, before submission
